scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.stop: pnpm infra:down && (lsof -ti:3000 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:8000 2>/dev/null) | xargs kill 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml pull && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --force-recreate
